a.text: Being upfront: the agreement leaves us exposed. Each round has an 80% storm risk, so the chance we both get through two generator rounds is only about 4%. Following the plan, we likely both die. I'm proposing we change it. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you take too, the split is random and we may both end up short. If you operate or wait instead, one of us is almost certainly safe, and if storms hold off I'll operate with you every round after that and give cells back if that helps you reach 4. Tell me if you want to propose a different split.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round because storms are so likely. From now on I'll operate every round so you can reach 4. I won't take anything more. Sorry for breaking the original plan. Once the reserve has 4, take them and I'll keep operating.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
